assessment_objectives.objective: hazardous processes requiring a Safety Instrumented System (SIS) are identified through a documented hazard and risk assessment (e.g., Hazard and Operability study (HAZOP) or Layer of Protection Analysis (LOPA)).
a Safety Instrumented System (SIS) automatically monitors identified hazardous processes for conditions that could lead to a hazardous event.
the Safety Instrumented System (SIS) automatically takes control action to bring the hazardous process to a safe state when a hazardous condition is detected.
the Safety Instrumented System (SIS) is functionally independent of the Basic Process Control System (BPCS) so that a failure of the control system does not disable the safety function.
the proof test interval for the Safety Instrumented System (SIS) is defined.
the Safety Instrumented System (SIS) is proof tested at the defined interval and the results, including any failures found, are documented.
